instruction: Tune the saturation and hue settings in VLC to make the video colors appear more vivid and appealing to my eyes.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because 'vivid and appealing' is a subjective aesthetic judgment that varies by individual preference. What appears 'more vivid' to one person may look oversaturated to another. There is no objective standard to evaluate visual appeal.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible due to subjective aesthetic requirements
Instruction requires judging 'vivid and appealing to my eyes' which has no objective verification standard
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate choice for tasks with purely subjective success criteria
Explanation accurately describes why objective verification is impossible for visual aesthetic preferences
